description: This PHP class defines an event handler for processing recurring invoice data associated with Sales Orders in vtiger CRM. It manages database updates or deletions based on the recurrence settings of a sales order.

classes.name: RecurringInvoiceHandler
classes.description: An event handler class that manages the creation, update, or deletion of recurring invoice information when sales order events occur.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Main method that triggers on specific events, processes sales order data related to recurring invoices, and performs database operations accordingly.
